description: This file is an HTML document that serves as the front-end interface for a database visualization tool. It contains markup, styles, and JavaScript for browsing databases, tables, and viewing table data.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the backend API and displays them in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases by re-fetching data from the API and updating the UI.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database's table list in the sidebar, loading tables if needed.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches tables for the selected database and displays them in the sidebar.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches data for a selected table and renders it in the main content area.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML to display table data with support for wide content and object visualization.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses a data cell containing long text or objects for better viewing.
